L0_MLP.hypothesis: L0_MLP detects whether the token at each position is a power of 2 (from the local token as single source) and emits a binary flag: the sign of its write vector encodes is-power-of-2 (-, -, -, +) vs not (+, +, +, -); ablating it causes many non-powers-of-2 to be misclassified as 1.
